integrity: Analytic proof with an explicitly credited classical sharp Khintchine inequality; finite-dimensional exact support tests and independent random-direction checks are corroboration, not general proofs.
scientific_limitations: The optimal center locus is proved to be a line segment but its endpoint formula is not established; results are for canonical unweighted generators and Euclidean metric; independent scientific validation remains outstanding.
title: The White Whale zonotope has a quadratic inball contact shell and a one-dimensional center locus
